lines.text: Many learners say: The class starts in nine o'clock.
Better: The class starts at nine o'clock.
At! We eat at nine o'clock.

data.wrong: The class starts in nine o'clock.
data.right: The class starts at nine o'clock.

en.tip: In Arabic we say «في الساعة التاسعة», but with clock time we use at: “The class starts at nine o'clock.” not “The class starts in nine o'clock.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “The class starts in nine o'clock.” 😅 In Arabic we say «في الساعة التاسعة», but with clock time we use at, so the right sentence is “The class starts at nine o'clock.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
